question: Can abstract functional-value priorities produce visibly different India-oriented high-end exteriors?

userFeedback.comment: 没看懂。四张过于相似，抽象的功能优先级没有成为可读的外观差异。

verdict: The batch did not communicate its design question clearly enough for preference judgment.
schemaLearning: Do not infer an exterior-design rule from this batch. Design Dialogue must propose visible geometric relationships rather than abstract product priorities.
